summary: Lightweight, modular JavaScript animation engine for complex timelines, SVG morphing, staggered reveals, and high-performance micro-interactions.
verification: Are animations bounded under 300ms for user-triggered micro-interactions?
Are transforms hardware accelerated (x, y, scale)?
Is prefers-reduced-motion honored by checking window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches?
whenToUse: Use when building JavaScript timeline animations, SVG morphing, or staggered list and grid reveals with Anime.js.
Use for animated number counters and chained entrance sequences outside a React-specific animation library.
